events.title: Nap Time in the Great Court
events.summary: A young boy naps on a wooden bench in the Great Court of the British Museum in London, his backpack beside him, while visitors stroll past glass display cases of ancient artifacts beneath the iconic glass-and-steel lattice roof.
events.place: Great Court, British Museum, London, United Kingdom

events.title: Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace
events.summary: A crowd watches soldiers in red tunics and bearskin hats march during the Changing of the Guard outside Buckingham Palace in London. Spectators in the foreground hold up phones to photograph the ceremony by the palace gates.

events.title: Kids Spotting Big Ben From London Eye
events.summary: Two children with backpacks press against the glass of a London Eye capsule, looking out over the River Thames toward the Palace of Westminster, Elizabeth Tower with Big Ben, and Westminster Bridge.

events.title: Punting Past King's College Chapel
events.summary: A young woman in a wooden punt trails her hand in the River Cam on a sunny day, with the Gothic towers of King's College Chapel rising on the riverbank behind her.
events.place: River Cam by King's College Chapel, Cambridge, UK

events.title: Gazing at Notre-Dame Rose Window
events.summary: A woman, a young boy, and a man gaze up in awe at the towering stained-glass rose window inside Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris. Colorful light from the windows reflects across the Gothic stone columns and arches around other visitors.
events.place: Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris, Paris, France

events.title: Morning Queue at Louvre Pyramid
events.summary: Two children in sun hats with backpacks walk toward the glass Louvre Pyramid in Paris on a sunny morning while other visitors wait in line to enter.

events.title: Champs-Élysées from Arc de Triomphe
events.summary: Looking east from the terrace of the Arc de Triomphe over the busy, tree-lined Avenue des Champs-Élysées in Paris. A child's hand with a blue watch rests on the stone parapet in the foreground.

events.title: Paris From Eiffel Tower Summit
events.summary: Looking east from the summit platform of the Eiffel Tower over Haussmann rooftops toward the Seine River and its bridges, with the tower's iron structure on the left.

events.title: Crowded Hall of Mirrors at Versailles
events.summary: Dozens of tourists fill the Hall of Mirrors inside the Palace of Versailles, surrounded by crystal chandeliers, floor-to-ceiling mirrors, tall windows, and the painted vaulted ceiling.
events.place: Hall of Mirrors, Palace of Versailles, Versailles, France

events.title: Evening Canal Cruise in Amsterdam
events.summary: Seen from a canal boat, a crowded tour boat glides under a brick bridge lined with parked bicycles, with classic gabled brick canal houses behind on Prinsengracht at sunset.

events.title: Watching the Night Watch Restoration
events.summary: Two conservators work on Rembrandt's The Night Watch inside its glass restoration chamber at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam while visitors, including children, watch closely.

events.title: Bikes at Zaanse Schans Windmills
events.summary: A boy crouches to adjust one of four light-blue rental bikes parked against a green fence. Behind them stand the historic thatched windmills of Zaanse Schans across the water under a partly cloudy sky.

events.title: Family Approaches Brandenburg Gate at Dusk
events.summary: A family of four walks toward the illuminated Brandenburg Gate in Berlin at dusk. The neoclassical monument with its Quadriga sculpture glows against the evening sky as other visitors gather nearby.
events.place: Brandenburg Gate, Pariser Platz, Berlin, Germany

events.title: Reading History at Berlin Wall Memorial
events.summary: A young woman reads an outdoor information plaque at the Berlin Wall Memorial on Bernauer Strasse in Berlin. Original concrete segments of the Berlin Wall and tall rusted steel posts stand behind her.
events.place: Berlin Wall Memorial, Bernauer Strasse, Berlin, Germany

events.title: Kids Exploring East Side Gallery Art
events.summary: Two children walk along the East Side Gallery in Berlin, stopping to look at the colorful Berlin Wall murals including the large red sun face mosaic. The young girl holds a pretzel while the boy with a backpack gazes up at the art on a sunny day.

events.title: Go-Karting on Tempelhof Runway
events.summary: A small child wearing a helmet rides a yellow pedal go-kart down the wide disused runway at Tempelhofer Feld in Berlin, with the historic curved Tempelhof Airport terminal building visible on the left under a partly cloudy sky.

events.title: Crowd Admiring Prague Astronomical Clock
events.summary: A crowd of tourists looks up at the medieval Prague Astronomical Clock on the Old Town Hall tower in Old Town Square, Prague. Adults and children gather on the cobblestones on a sunny summer day.
events.place: Prague Astronomical Clock, Old Town Hall, Old Town Square, Prague, Czech Republic

events.title: Sunset on Charles Bridge Prague
events.summary: Statues on Charles Bridge are silhouetted at sunset over the Vltava River, with the red rooftops of Mala Strana and Prague Castle with St. Vitus Cathedral on the hill in the background.

events.title: Kids Admiring St. Vitus Cathedral
events.summary: Two children with backpacks stand before and gaze up at the towering Gothic west facade with its rose window of St. Vitus Cathedral at Prague Castle.
events.place: St. Vitus Cathedral, Prague Castle, Prague, Czechia

events.title: Gloriette View Over Schönbrunn Gardens
events.summary: Early morning visitors stroll the Great Parterre below the Gloriette, looking north across formal lawns, hedges and the Neptune Fountain toward Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna.

events.title: Original Sachertorte at Café Sacher
events.summary: Two slices of Original Sachertorte with whipped cream and two steaming mugs of hot chocolate on a marble table inside Café Sacher in Vienna.

events.title: Approaching Rialto Bridge by Boat
events.summary: A view from a boat on the Grand Canal in Venice looking toward the white stone arch of the Rialto Bridge, with historic waterfront palazzi lining both sides of the blue water.
events.place: Rialto Bridge, Grand Canal, Venice, Italy

events.title: Glass Souvenir by Burano Canal
events.summary: A young girl examines a blue Murano glass pendant on a bridge over a canal in Burano, Venice. Behind her are the island's famous pink, blue and yellow houses with laundry hanging above and a small boat moored in the canal.

events.title: Florence Rooftops from Duomo Dome
events.summary: Hazy afternoon panorama from the dome of Florence Cathedral looking southeast over terracotta rooftops toward Palazzo Vecchio with its tower and crenellated palace rising above the city.
events.place: Florence Cathedral (Cattedrale di Santa Maria del Fiore), Florence, Italy

events.title: Sunset over Florence from Piazzale
events.summary: Crowds sit on the stone steps of Piazzale Michelangelo in Florence at sunset, overlooking the city. The Duomo with Brunelleschi's Dome, Giotto's Campanile, the Arno River and Ponte Vecchio are clearly visible as the sun sets behind the hills.

events.title: Bandaged Knee on Piazza del Campo
events.summary: A young boy with a bandaged knee sits on the brick pavement of Piazza del Campo in Siena, Italy. Behind him tourists cross the square in front of the Palazzo Pubblico and its tall Torre del Mangia under a clear blue sky.

events.title: Sunlit Arches Inside the Colosseum
events.summary: Tourists including a woman and a small boy with backpacks walk through the ancient brick-arched corridors of the Colosseum in Rome as sunlight streams through the vaults.

events.title: Tossing a Coin at Trevi Fountain
events.summary: A boy with a backpack stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, appearing to toss a coin toward the Trevi Fountain in Rome. Crowds of tourists surround the Baroque fountain and its turquoise basin with the Palazzo Poli facade and central Oceanus statue behind.

events.title: Kids Racing Into Barceloneta Sunset
events.summary: Two children run into the waves at Platja de la Barceloneta at sunset. The sail-shaped W Barcelona hotel and Barcelona seafront skyline stand out in the golden light across the water.
events.place: Platja de la Barceloneta, Barcelona, Spain

events.title: Sagrada Família Nativity Facade in Morning
events.summary: A low-angle view looking up at the highly ornate Nativity Facade of the Basílica de la Sagrada Família in Barcelona, showing its carved stone spires, sculptures and stained glass with cranes and scaffolding overhead.
events.place: Basílica de la Sagrada Família, Barcelona, Spain

events.title: Mosaic Terrace Overlooking Barcelona
events.summary: The colorful trencadís serpentine bench curves across the Nature Square terrace at Park Güell, framing Gaudí's twin gatehouses with panoramic views of Barcelona and the Mediterranean Sea beyond.

events.title: Montserrat Abbey Under Serrated Peaks
events.summary: Rack railway tracks curve from a station platform toward the stone buildings of the Santa Maria de Montserrat Abbey and its basilica apse, set directly beneath the towering serrated rock pillars of the Montserrat massif.
events.place: Santa Maria de Montserrat Abbey, Monistrol de Montserrat, Spain
